# Checker roster. Regenerated by scripts/checker_audit.sh --regen.
# Every uvm_error / uvm_fatal / uvm_warning site in tb/uvm, with the
# class a human assigned it. A new site arrives as '?', and '?' is a
# hard failure, so a site cannot enter the environment unclassified.
#
#   STRUCT   testbench wiring: a null interface, a missing config.
#            No RTL change can provoke one.
#   VACUOUS  detects ABSENCE. Provable by removing the stimulus.
#   INSTR    the instrument checking itself.
#   PROGARG  a bad plusarg or program argument.
#   REF      the reference model could not step.
#   DESIGN   a property of the DUT. The mutation-testable target.
#
#   mech     DESIGN rows only: the MECHANISM, because a site is not one.
#   mut      DESIGN rows only: the mutation that PROVED the mechanism
#            can fail. Empty means never shown able to fail, which is
#            a hypothesis. See docs/verification.md: a cell counts as
#            a proof only if a log contains the checker own words.
#
# file|id|fingerprint|class|mech|mut
